title: ConvergeFlow: Language Flow with Provable Convergence to Token Embeddings

summary.en: ConvergeFlow parameterizes its data predictor as a convex combination of token embeddings, combining learned base weights with a Gaussian corruption kernel. Flow-matching MSE trains the predictor; under stated assumptions, the flow approaches token embeddings without a separately CE-trained decoding head.
summary.zh: ConvergeFlow 将数据预测器参数化为 token 嵌入的凸组合，结合学习到的基础权重与高斯扰动核，并用 flow-matching MSE 训练。在给定假设下，连续 flow 走向 token 嵌入，无需单独训练 CE 解码头。

cover.alt: Animated conceptual overview of ConvergeFlow: learned base weights and a Gaussian kernel define a convex embedding predictor; repeated flow updates approach vocabulary embeddings for terminal readout without a separately CE-trained decoder, under the stated convergence assumptions.

note.en: Reported operating points from Table 1. GenPPL is scored by GPT-2 Large; entropy is mean within-sequence unigram entropy. ConvergeFlow uses LangFlow initialization, frozen pretrained embeddings, and 175k additional MSE updates, with sampling controls tuned toward dataset entropy 5.44. Model sizes and training/sampling budgets differ; these scores do not isolate architecture gains or speed. The convergence theorem requires regularity and time-grid conditions. Date: initial arXiv submission, August 24, 2026.
note.zh: 采用论文表 1 的报告值。GenPPL 由 GPT-2 Large 评测，熵为序列内 unigram 熵的均值。ConvergeFlow 使用 LangFlow 初始化、固定的预训练嵌入及额外 175k 次 MSE 更新，采样控制调整至接近数据集熵 5.44。模型大小与训练、采样预算不同，这些分数不能单独归因于架构或速度收益。收敛定理要求正则性与时间网格条件。日期为 arXiv 首次提交日（2026-08-24）。
